messages:
Helen: Heads up — I opened a docs PR to update the model-catalog model cards with per-variant throughput + memory rows, and a short migration guide for legacy quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1456 :link:

docs-bot: PR opened by Helen — #1456 (model-catalog: variant throughput + quant migration)

Matt: Nice. Does this include numbers from the latest bench run on A10G? We need seq=1024 and seq=4096 columns for customer-facing guidance.

Sophie: Yes — I added two new columns (throughput @1024, throughput @4096) and a tiny note on how we amortize token costs. Also included an SDK v4 streaming + cpu-fallback snippet. Example below:

```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY'))
# stream with explicit fallback to a CPU quantized variant
resp = client.generate("Summarize the following...", model="aurora-lite3b", stream=True, fallback_model="aurora-lite3b-cpu-quant")
for chunk in resp:
    # chunk may be partial; handle incrementally
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

Raman: Quick question — are we confident about publishing absolute throughput numbers? I'd prefer calling them "measured on A10G with perf harness v2" and link to the bench shot. We should avoid implying cross-hardware parity.

Kevin: Agreed. I fixed the benchlink in the PR to point at the canonical shot: https://bench.redwood/shots/57234 and ran the harness with seed=42. I also updated the README note: "Numbers reflect p50 throughput for sequence lengths 1024 and 4096 on A10G; your mileage may vary."

Sophie: Small nit — in the migration notes I added a mapping block for old quant profiles -> new variant names so users can grep and replace. Paste: 

legacy_quant_v1 -> aurora-lite3b-quant-v1
legacy_quant_small -> aurora-lite3b-cpu-quant
legacy_int8 -> aurora-lite3b-int8-v2

I also added a short regex suggestion for SDK users: `s/legacy_quant_([a-z0-9_-]+)/aurora-lite3b-\1/` (adjust per model).

Matt: Can we include a one-liner CLI command to update local configs? e.g. `rg "legacy_quant" -l | xargs sed -i 's/legacy_quant/aurora-lite3b-/'` — might be too aggressive but handy for large repos.

Sophie: Added a safe example that uses a confirm step: `rg "legacy_quant" -l | xargs -I{} sh -c "echo {}; sed -n '1,3p' {}; read -p 'Replace? (y/N)' ans; [ \"$ans\" = \"y\" ] && sed -i 's/legacy_quant/aurora-lite3b-/' {}"` — annotated it as advanced.

Helen: One more item — the model-catalog index should surface a new flag: `compatibility: streaming, function-calls` for variants that support streaming+tools. Can someone add that to the index YAML?

Kevin: Done in the PR — added `compatibility` as a comma-separated list for each variant. Also normalized the variant IDs (no uppercase).

Raman: LGTM on wording. Suggest we add a tiny FAQ blurb: "Why does throughput vary between variants?" and a pointer to the runtime docs about batching/kv-cache.

Sophie: Added FAQ + pointer to https://docs.redwood.ai/runtime/batching and a short sentence about how caching reduces cold-start cost.

Matt: LGTM :thumbsup:

Raman: LGTM

docs-bot: PR #1456 merged by Helen — commit abcd123. Docs deploy scheduled for 2026-03-12 23:00 UTC :rocket:
